opennyai_summary.8_May_2025__facts:

opennyai_summary.8_May_2025__arguments:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
The allegation against the applicant is of forgery on the basis of impersonation and received Rs.5.00 lacs in the transaction.
opennyai_summary.8_May_2025__ANALYSIS:
The case of the present applicant is similar to that of co-accused.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
However, he has admitted that allegation against the applicant is that he has received Rs.5.00 lacs in the said transaction and he is having parity with co-accused Gajendra Singh.
4. Having considered the rival submissions and looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, custody period of applicant so also the ground of parity with co-accused, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to extend benefit of bail to the applicant.
opennyai_summary.8_May_2025__decision:
Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.
5. It is directed that applicant be released on bail, subject to depositing Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees Five lacs only) before the Trial Court and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the said Court on the dates given by the concerned Court during pendency of trial.
It is further directed that the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12283 3 MCRC-20400-2025 applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
6.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
7. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
